blocks.html: Looking for a staycation experience away from the metro? To help you cool down the intense heat of summer, a stay at Summit Ridge can provide you with the most fun and comfortable experience while enjoying the cool breeze and clean environment of Tagaytay.

Located at the highest point of Tagaytay ridge, Summit Ridge is a pleasant hour's drive away from Manila via South Luzon Expressway, and it is conveniently located near must-go places like the famous Mahogany market, known wedding churches, and different culinary hotspots.

"Summit Ridge Tagaytay continually makes notable brand tie-ups that make a staycation at our hotel more memorable with thoughtful complimentary guest perks and such. These tie-ups also come with different offers and privileges that are uniquely inspired by Tagaytay as a destination!" said Pops del Rosario, Summit Ridge Hotel's general manager.

"Enjoy movie viewing under the stars, shop for fresh produce at the nearby organic market, or cook your family favorites in your very own kitchen (available in all two-bedroom suites), all for health, bonding and better family time!
